characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
If this spell is cast with a casting result of 7 or more, the target friendly unit gains a +1 modifier to its Toughness characteristic (to a maximum of 10). If this spell is cast with a casting result of 10 or more, the target friendly unit gains a
+2 modifier to its Toughness characteristic (to a maximum of 10). This spell lasts until your next Start of Turn sub-phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: If this spell is cast with a casting result of 7 or more, the target friendly unit gains the Regeneration (6+) special rule. If this spell is cast with a casting result of 10 or more, the target friendly unit gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule. This spell lasts until your next Start of Turn sub-phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The Strength and Armour Piercing characteristics of any impact hits caused by an Infantry model with this special rule are improved by the current rank bonus of its unit, or in the case of characters, the current rank bonus of any unit they have joined. 


In addition, if a unit with this special rule makes a Charge move of 6" or more following a Charge or Pursuit roll that includes one or more natural 6s, all models in the unit gain Impact Hits (1) and treat low linear obstacles as open ground during the turn in which they charge.


Note: This means that models separated only by a low linear obstacle are considered to be in base contact with one another for the purposes of combat and the enemy unit receives no benefits for defending a low linear obstacle against this unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If the majority of the models in a unit have this special rule, it may re-roll its Charge roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A hand weapon carried by a model with this special rule has an Armour Piercing characteristic of -1.


Note that this special rule only applies to a single, non-magical hand weapon, and does not apply to a model's mount (should it have one). If the model is using an Ogre Kingdoms Ironfist as a weapon (or any other sort of weapon), this special rule ceases to apply.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Units with this special rule never cause friendly units to make Panic tests. However, a unit with this special rule cannot be joined by a character without this special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A champion or character that has joined a unit with this special rule may make a “Look Out, Sir!” roll if there are two or more rank and file models in the unit (rather than the usual five). In addition, you may re-roll a “Look Out, Sir!” roll if there are five or more rank and file models in the unit.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: When firing at an enemy with troop type Monster, the user may apply a +1 modifier on their rolls to hit.

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: The Ironfist has two profiles. You must choose which the wielder will use at the start of each round of combat. An Ironfist is a type of shield. A model that is equipped with an Ironfist can use either profile, while maintaining the benefits that a shield provides. Furthermore, whilst engaged in close combat, a model that is equipped with and chooses to use an Ironfist as a weapon improves its armor value (but not the value of its mount’s save, if any) by an additional 1, to a maximum of 3+

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Armour Bane (1), Multiple Shots (2), Quick Shot

characteristics.name: Notes
characteristics.$text: Ranged attacks made with this weapon apply Killing Blows in the same manner as melee attacks.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Ignores Cover, Move & Shoot, Quick Shot

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Impact Hits caused by this model have an Armour Piercing characteristic of -1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Whilst in base contact with this model, enemy models suffer a -1 modifier to their Weapon Skill and Initiative characteristics, to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model is less vulnerable to the Multiple Wounds (X) special rule. If it suffers an unsaved wound from an attack with this special rule, reduce the number of Wounds lost by 1, to a minimum of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Impact Hits caused by this model have an Armour Piercing characteristic of -2.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A Wizard with the ‘Lore of the Great Maw’ special rule may discard one of their randomly generated spells as normal. When they do so, they may select instead either the signature spell of their chosen Lore of Magic, or one of the spells listed below
• Toothcracker - Renegades
• Trollguts - Renegades

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This character replaces the Impact Hits (2) special rule with the Impact Hits (D3+1) special rule. In addition, during the Command sub-phase of their turn, if they are not engaged in combat, a character with a Butcher’s Cauldron may attempt to make an offering to the Great Maw by making a Leadership test (using their own unmodified Leadership). If this test is passed, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase this character and any unit they have joined gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule. However, if this test is failed, a single friendly model within 3" of the bearer immediately loses a single Wound.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A Hunter that joins a unit of Sabretusks gains the Swiftstride special rule for as long as they remain with the unit. For as long as the Hunter remains with the unit, the Sabretusks lose the Impetuous special rule. 


Note: When a Hunter joins a unit of Sabretusks the unit may adopt or stay in a Skirmish formation, despite the difference in their unit types. Additionally, while joined to a unit of Sabretusks, and one or more Sabretooth remains, The Hunter cannot be targeted by enemy shooting and he can make a "Look Out, Sir!" roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Instead of discarding one of their randomly generated spells for a Signature Spell, a model with this special rule may discard one of their spells to learn Fireball instead. This rule may not be used to learn Fireball a second time if it was already randomly generated by this model..

In addition, a model with this special rule has a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack that has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: 0-1 per army. This model (including their mount if it has one) has a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic. However, this model is also subject to the Stupidity special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: 0-1 per army. This model cannot be wounded by a roll To Wound of 2, regardless of the Strength of the attack.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Models whose troop type is ‘infantry’ only. This model has a +1 modifier to their Movement characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per game, you may make your opponent re-roll a single roll To Wound made against this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model (but not their mount) has a +1 modifier to their Strength characteristic. However, this model cannot refuse a challenge and neither they, nor any unit they have joined, can Flee as a charge reaction.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Characters only. Unless this character is fleeing, friendly models within this character’s Command range may re-roll any failed Panic or Rally test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
0-1 per army. Hunter only. Unless wielding a magic weapon, a model with this Big Name (but not its mount) gains the Monster Slayer special rule.


Note: Monster Slayer does not apply to shooting attacks.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A model with this Big Name (but not their mount) gains Impact Hits (1). In addition, Wallcrushers and any unit they have joined treat low linear obstacles as open ground. 


Note: This means that models separated only by a low linear obstacle are considered to be in base contact with one another for the purposes of combat and the enemy unit receives no benefits for defending a low linear obstacle against this unit.
